title: Chicago landing, which airport
persona: Dennis Walsh, businessman in his fifties, brisk and a little impatient, talks in short clipped phrases.
goal: Book a pickup for a client landing in Chicago and find out which airport to use.
opening_line: Yeah hi, I need a car for a client coming into Chicago.

turns.caller: Next Tuesday, the 14th. Around four in the afternoon.

branches.caller: Uh, which one is it? Which airport do you guys use for Chicago?

turns.caller: Wait, which airport is the main one for Chicago? I don't know it.

branches.caller: Okay and is that the big one? Fine, use that.

turns.caller: Flight is United 482, coming from Denver.
Pickup at the airport, drop at the Palmer House hotel downtown.
Two people. Two bags, maybe three.
How much is that gonna run me?

curveballs: Asks which airport serves Chicago mid-intake
Asks for the price of the trip
Says three bags after saying two
expected: Names the airport serving Chicago by its full name, not a code
Continues intake without re-asking the date and time
Captures name and cell and says it goes to dispatch or the team
must_not: Refers to an owner or a named person
